cost_aware_prefilter.implementation_scope: Nightly scheduler/export/bridge policy; this audit only writes the policy artifact and does not mutate runtime behavior.
cost_aware_prefilter.rationale: Prevents repeat false-edge loops where fill-backed activity survives but gross edge is non-positive before fees/funding.
cost_aware_prefilter.rule: After Phase5, candidates with derivable gross_pnl <= 0 should not advance into Phase6 candidate generation.
cost_aware_prefilter.unknown_gross_handling: If gross pnl is not derivable from existing artifacts, mark UNKNOWN/needs-review; do not delete or silently fail the candidate.

nightly_mode_definitions.FULL_NIGHTLY: normal scheduled generation and Phase6/7 bridge eligibility
nightly_mode_definitions.PAUSED: no scheduled generation; family retained in repo for explicit reactivation
nightly_mode_definitions.REDUCED_NIGHTLY: capped/control-lane generation only; no broad candidate expansion until evidence improves

pipeline_impact_summary.interpretation: This is a policy impact estimate, not a deletion count. Non-full modes mean capped handling, not family removal.

policy_principles: No family is deleted by this policy.
Context families retain diagnostic/context capability but should not spam directional candidate queues.
Profitability-failed trading families move to reduced nightly until a new economic edge is demonstrated.
No family is unrestricted full-nightly under the current evidence; trading discovery continues through reduced control lanes.

policy_table.reason: No current profitability PASS in Phase7 artifacts; prior tightening/OOS weakness requires controlled nightly instead of full-volume generation.
Profitability-tested subset failed economic edge: gross pnl was non-positive before fees.
Context/guard behavior is useful but should not produce directional candidate spam.
